verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a notarization, incorporation and translation service exposed through a REST API and webhooks, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes external tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or agent-host capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
